meaning.en: The act by which something is unwound.

sentences.en: Wind up the string by turning the flyers different ways, so that the spring of the bow may unwind them with their anterior edges ascending; then place the cork with the bow attached to it upon a table, and with a finger on the upper cork press strong enough to prevent the string from unwinding, and, taking it away suddenly, the instrument will rise to the ceiling."

sentences.en: That in turn will largely determine how successfully we can achieve an orderly unwinding of the present imbalances.

sentences.en: These soothing, warm colors are perfect for the bedroom to help create a tranquil, relaxing atmosphere for unwinding, resting or just escaping the stresses of everyday life.

sentences.en: If you find yourself in that category, then you'll find the online version of this game a perfect choice for unwinding at day's end.

sentences.en: Abdar-rahman's army was so ill provided that he mounted almost the only good war-horse in it; he had no banner, and one was improvised by unwinding a green turban and binding it round the head of a spear.
sentences.vi: Quân đội của Abdar-rahman bị ốm đến nỗi ông ta gần như chỉ có một con chiến mã tốt trong đó; anh ta không có biểu ngữ, và một người đã ngẫu hứng bằng cách cuộn một chiếc khăn xếp màu xanh lá cây và buộc nó quanh đầu một ngọn giáo.
